critical_warnings: Route 35-39: design did not meet timing

comparative_evidence.interpretation: R3 failure is correlated with changed placement/routing pressure after the control-topology change. This does not prove a unique root cause in SmartConnect.

bounded_refinement.name: R3-T1-LOCAL166P667
bounded_refinement.change: Only requested local clock frequency changes from 200.000 MHz to 166.667 MHz; R3 topology, DP6 blob, memory map and control apertures remain unchanged.
bounded_refinement.rationale: Worst observed local DP6 path exceeded the 5.000 ns period by ~0.843 ns. A 166.667 MHz target gives a nominal 6.000 ns period, adding ~1.000 ns local timing budget without semantic/address changes.
bounded_refinement.caveat: This does not guarantee physical closure because shell/DDR timing and placement sensitivity remain; only a separately authorized future physical implementation can prove timing.

epistemic_boundary: Observed timing paths and congestion are evidence of the failure surface, not proof of a unique root cause.
